outcome: proportion of patients losing >1000 mL of blood
cohort: The study participants were patients undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: Tranexamic Acid (TA) administration significantly reduced bleeding during CS, the proportion of patients who lost more than 1000 mL of blood, and the need for supplemental uterotonic substances.
mod_finding: TA administration during caesarean section dramatically reduced bleeding, the proportion of patients losing more than 1000 mL of blood, and the requirement for supplemental uterotonic substances.
